{{Top|notoc=1}}
A '''Klaxon''' was a type of alarm. Many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were equipped with Klaxon alarms.<ref name="LSSOM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' (1st edition hardcover)</ref><ref name="XWSC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'' (1st edition paperback)</ref><ref name="LotfS">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' (1st edition hardcover)</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Klaxon|Klaxon]] is a trademark for a real-world brand of alarm produced by [http://www.klaxonsignals.com Klaxon Signals, Ltd.], but the term's common usage has come to describe any alarm with an "ah-ooh-gah" sound. The term is capitalized in several ''Star Wars'' novels.<!-- Important note: For "Notes and references", only references where "Klaxon" is capitalized WITHOUT being the first word of a sentence should be added. --><ref name="LSSOM" /><ref name="XWSC" /><ref name="LotfS" />
